flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi (src/main/java/.../framework): workflows/agencies/toppan/{upload/jobs/{ToppanLettersGeneratorJob,ToppanUploadJob},upload/services/ToppanLettersGeneratorServiceImpl,report/{jobs/ToppanReportJob,helpers/ToppanReportHelper},download/{jobs/ToppanDownloadJob,helpers/ToppanResponseParser}}, schedulers/{ToppanUploadJobsScheduler,ToppanDownloadJobsScheduler}, controllers/ToppanUnifiedController, application-prod.properties, cron-schedules-prod.properties. ocmsadminapi: workflows/reports/agency/toppan/{ToppanReportController,ToppanReportServiceImpl}, filedownload/downloadfile/FileDownloadController, auth/interceptor/OcmsAuthorizationInterceptor, api-authorization.properties. ocmsadminui: pages/Report/lists/{ReportList,ReportListReminder}.tsx, pages/Cron/list/CronList.tsx. ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: not used
note: Requirement given (status 'Requirement given - Gen flow'); demo_remark: 'SFTP. Code Split. Permission for SFTP connection is granted to the api App Service server.' The story asks for a daily summary report of letters sent to the vendor (including interface errors), routed to the OIC's dashboard and downloadable. The code has three parts: (1) an Excel Summary from the CSR and a Detailed RD & DN report from the tracking tables, both emailed, (2) a Reminder tab on the Report page that lists raw blob files and (3) a download button. Main gaps: no interface error section in the report, the Excel reports do not reach the dashboard (email only), the Generate Letters job is not scheduled in the day-end scheduler, Toppan SFTP uploads are blocked in production by a property (OCMS-DF-2026-192 Ready to UAT), and function OCMS_REPORT_REMINDER has no /v1/download/blob permission. The active code is in ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java; the folder ocmsadminprivateapi/cronservice is an old uncompiled copy (different version) and was not used as evidence. Email delivery, Toppan SFTP and the content of the ACK/LOG files: cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Claim partially. The Summary and Detailed reports exist and are sent by email; do not claim in full until: interface errors are in the report, the Excel reports show on the dashboard, the Generate Letters job is scheduled, and function OCMS_REPORT_REMINDER gets /v1/download/blob. Ask URA whether email delivery plus raw files on the dashboard is enough for 'route to the dashboard'.

steps.step: Letters (data files) per stage RD1/RD2/RR3/DN1/DN2/DR3/ANL are sent to the Toppan vendor over SFTP
steps.detail: ToppanUploadJob builds the request file URA-DPT-<stage>-D1-<timestamp>, uploads it to blob (ToppanUploadJob.java:314) and then requests a COMCRYPT token to push it to the Toppan SFTP (:349). However, the day-end scheduler has the 'Toppan Generate Letters' job commented out (ToppanUploadJobsScheduler.java:118), so this cron only runs through a manual trigger (POST generate-letters, ToppanUnifiedController.java:34). application-prod.properties:86 also blocks Toppan SFTP uploads (sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan) and the delivery gate is bypassed while the block is active (ToppanUploadJob.java:426), so the stage still advances even when the file is not delivered. Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-192 (Ready to UAT) covers the job failing on manual trigger. Whether the file really reaches the Toppan SFTP in production: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: OCMS generates a daily summary report of the letters sent (count per data file and total reminders)
steps.detail: After the letters are built, ToppanLettersGeneratorJob writes the Control Summary Report (CSR, file URA-DPT-CTL-S1-<timestamp>) holding the reminder count per data file and 'Total number of Reminders' (ToppanLettersGeneratorJob.java:485, :491). ToppanLettersGeneratorServiceImpl calls generateReport after the job finishes, whatever the result (:56-58). ToppanReportJob fetches the CSR from blob (ToppanReportHelper.java:260), parses each row and the total (:321-322), builds an Excel 'Summary' sheet (Data File Name, No. of Reminders, total; :394-416) and attaches it (ToppanReportJob.java:135-152). Note: the numbers come from a file OCMS wrote itself (what was handed over), not from a Toppan confirmation, and the ANL stage is excluded from the CSR through toppan.upload.anl.exclude.csr=true (application.properties:209).

steps.step: The report holds the details of the letters sent (per notice, stage, recipient name/ID, address, postal registration number)
steps.detail: generateAndSendDetailedRdDnReport builds a two-sheet 'Detailed RD & DN' Excel (RD1/RD2/RR3 and DN1/DN2/DR3) with columns S/N, stage, notice no., type, offence date, vehicle no., rule, place, amount, name, ID, address and Postal Reg. No. (ToppanReportHelper.java:487-490) and attaches the ACK files from Toppan (ToppanReportJob.java:259-306). It runs after the ACK download at 01:30 (ToppanDownloadJobsScheduler.java:73-79). But: the postal registration number only exists once Toppan has returned the RD2/DN2 files (ToppanStageTransitionService.java:42), the report uses today's date so a Toppan turnaround longer than one day is not caught (the scheduler comment :73-78 admits this), and the ANL stage is not included. Content of the Toppan ACK files: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The report includes interface errors (if any) from sending to the vendor
steps.detail: The Excel Summary only holds counts per data file and a total (ToppanReportHelper.java:394-416); there is no error sheet or section. Failed notices from the Toppan ACK file are parsed (ToppanResponseParser.java:285) but only written to the log (ToppanDownloadJob.java:457-458), not into a report. Job failures show up in the Job Execution Report emailed after the ACK download (ToppanDownloadJobsScheduler.java:80) and in the day-end SMS alert (ToppanUploadJobsScheduler.java:129), but that SMS counts the commented-out Toppan Generate Letters job as not successful (:118). The Toppan LOG files (DPT-URA-LOG-*) are attached and shown on the dashboard, so errors from the Toppan side may be readable there; their content: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The report is produced every day (daily)
steps.detail: The Detailed RD & DN report runs daily through the Toppan Download cron at 01:30 (cron-schedules-prod.properties:90-91; ToppanDownloadJobsScheduler.java:51, :79). The Summary (CSR) report is only produced when the Generate Letters cron runs, and in the 00:15 scheduler (cron-schedules-prod.properties:61; ToppanUploadJobsScheduler.java:95) that job is commented out (:118); only the manual 'Toppan Generate Letters' button on the Cron list exists (CronList.tsx:45). So the Summary report is not scheduled daily in this repo. The schedule actually active in production: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The report is routed to the OIC's dashboard (Report page, Reminder tab)
steps.detail: The Reminder tab on the Report page (shown when the user has function OCMS_REPORT_REMINDER; ReportList.tsx:108) calls toppan-report/search (ReportListReminder.tsx:75) and lists blob files per date, from source CRS (the daily input folder, holding the CSR and data files; ToppanReportServiceImpl.java:78) and ACKNOWLEDGEMENT (five DPT-URA-* prefixes; :182-188), with a maximum range of 31 days. But the Excel Summary and Detailed RD & DN files are not stored in blob, they are only sent by email (ToppanReportJob.java:230, :291), so the dashboard shows the raw files (CSR/ACK), not the Excel reports the jobs build.

steps.step: The OIC can download the report to see the details of the letters sent
steps.detail: The Download button in the grid calls POST download/blob with source TOPPAN or TOPPAN_INPUT (ReportListReminder.tsx:46; FileDownloadController.java:89-90, :114) and then saveAs (ReportListReminder.tsx:54). There is a gap: the OCMS_REPORT_REMINDER function mapping only contains /v1/toppan-report/search and /v1/standardcodelist (api-authorization.properties:144-145), without /v1/download/blob, while sibling reports such as OCMS_REPORT_MHA have it (:135-136). The interceptor rejects any URI that does not start with an allowed path (OcmsAuthorizationInterceptor.java:68; registered for all paths in WebConfig.java:79). So a user who holds only OCMS_REPORT_REMINDER gets a 403 on download; it only works if the user has another function that includes /v1/download/blob. The function combination per OIC role: cannot verify from repo. What gets downloaded is the raw CSR/ACK file (see the dashboard step).
